# docker
docker container inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-api
docker image inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-api:base
docker image inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-api:snap
docker volume inspect aide-api-creds
docker volume inspect aide-api-cache
docker image inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-web:base
docker image inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-web:snap
docker container inspect -f '{{json .}}' aide-web
docker commit aide-web aide-api:snap
docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' aide-api:snap
docker tag aide-web:base aide-api:base
docker volume inspect aide-web-creds
docker volume create aide-api-creds
docker run --rm --entrypoint cp --mount type=volume,src=aide-web-creds,dst=/from,readonly --mount type=volume,src=aide-api-creds,dst=/to aide-web:base -a /from/. /to/
